bit_timing_structure.BIT_TIME: 1 / Bit Rate. HDLC does not constrain bit rate — common deployments: 2400 bps (asynchronous), 9.6/64/2048 kbps (synchronous V.24/V.35), 2.048 Mbps (E1), 1.544 Mbps (T1).
bit_timing_structure.CLOCK_RECOVERY_SYNC: NRZI encoding + guaranteed bit-stuffing transition rule (max 6 ones followed by a stuffed 0 → at least one transition every 6 bit times within frame body; max 7 bit times during continuous flag idle).
bit_timing_structure.CLOCK_RECOVERY_ASYNC: Receiver re-syncs per octet via start/stop bits (RS-232 style); not bit-stuffing dependent.
bit_timing_structure.SAMPLE_POINT: Mid-bit (typical UART convention) on asynchronous; clock-recovered on synchronous; protocol does not mandate a specific within-bit sample point.

synchronization_waveform.FLAG_HUNT: Receiver scans incoming bit stream for the 8-bit 0x7E pattern (01111110). On match, receiver enters frame body de-stuffing.
synchronization_waveform.FLAG_SHARING: End-flag of one frame MAY be shared as start-flag of next: bit sequence '01111110 01111110' becomes '011111101111110' with the middle '0' shared (saves 1 octet on back-to-back frames).
synchronization_waveform.ABORT_DETECT: Receiver counts consecutive 1-bits within frame body; 7 or more without a 0-bit = abort, return to FLAG_HUNT.

frame_waveform.I_FRAME: FLAG (8b 0x7E) → ADDRESS (8+ bits, stuffed) → CONTROL (8 or 16 bits, stuffed; low-bit=0) → INFORMATION (variable, stuffed) → FCS (16 or 32 bits, stuffed) → FLAG (8b 0x7E)
frame_waveform.S_FRAME: FLAG → ADDRESS → CONTROL (low-bits=01, no info) → FCS → FLAG
frame_waveform.U_FRAME: FLAG → ADDRESS → CONTROL (low-bits=11) → INFORMATION (only for UI/UIH/XID/TEST/SM/FRMR) → FCS → FLAG
frame_waveform.ABORT: ARBITRARY-LENGTH partial frame → 7+ consecutive 1-bits → next FLAG (or continuous 1-idle)
frame_waveform.BACK_TO_BACK: FLAG-shared transmission: ...FCS (frame N) → 0x7E shared flag → ADDRESS (frame N+1)...

interframe_state_waveform.IDLE_CONTINUOUS_ONES: Continuous 1-bit level; receiver remains in FLAG_HUNT.
interframe_state_waveform.IDLE_CONTINUOUS_FLAGS: Continuous repeating 0x7E pattern; both serve as link-active idle.
interframe_state_waveform.DEAD_LINK: No signal / continuous 0-bits (synchronous): indicates loss of carrier; receiver loses bit-clock recovery.

synchronous_framing_continuous_waveform_: When no frames are transmitted on a simplex or full-duplex synchronous link, a frame delimiter is continuously transmitted. Two continuous waveforms result depending on initial state — both have a 0-to-1 transition pattern that maintains modem clock recovery.

asynchronous_framing_octet_stuffing_wave.flag_octet_in_payload: 0x7E in payload is transmitted as 0x7D 0x5E (escape octet 0x7D followed by 0x7E XOR 0x20 = 0x5E).
asynchronous_framing_octet_stuffing_wave.escape_octet_in_payload: 0x7D in payload is transmitted as 0x7D 0x5D (escape octet 0x7D followed by 0x7D XOR 0x20 = 0x5D).
asynchronous_framing_octet_stuffing_wave.abort_sequence: 0x7D 0x7E ends a packet with an incomplete byte-stuff sequence (forcing receiver to detect error).
asynchronous_framing_octet_stuffing_wave.other_escapable_octets: XON (0x11) / XOFF (0x13) MAY be escaped via the same 0x7D + (octet XOR 0x20) mechanism for in-band flow control transparency.

poll_final_waveform.Poll: P-bit set in command frame; primary station solicits response from secondary.
poll_final_waveform.Final: F-bit set in response frame; secondary indicates response (or end of transmission).
poll_final_waveform.checkpoint: Only one P/F token in flight per direction; arrival of P/F at a station signals that any frames it sent before its last P/F transmission and not yet acknowledged will never arrive.
